description: 24 harder synthetic packing tasks (8 per two-box pairing), composed only from (object, box) subtasks that appear as possible in chunks.json. Each task uses exactly the two listed box sizes and consists of 5-8 single-object Pack subtasks (6 tasks of each length: 5, 6, 7, 8; 2 tasks of each length per box pairing). Subtasks are grouped smaller-box-first (the first listed box gets the smaller share of objects), matching the majority ordering in chunks.json. Objects are distinct within a task.
